the international and domestic research performances of the evaluated projects have increased, and that the research performance measured by CIF correlates significantly with the research performance measured in SCI-IF.

the key projects in Information Science & technology, funded by the National Natural Science Foundation, are more productive in terms of international outputs and the most productive subdisciplines are semiconductor and automation.

the evaluation of domestic and foreign outputs of the key research projects funded by NSFC.
the evaluation of the research performance of key research projects in information science & technology in China.

the international and domestic research performance of the key projects in information science & technology, and the results provide useful references for the evaluation and selection of the projects in the future.

the key projects in the domain of information science &technology funded by NSFC during the study period have, to different extents, achieved international and domestic research outputs.

the research performance of the key projects in the area of information science &technology funded by NSFC during the period 2004-2001 is generally satisfactory, but still needs to be improved further.

the research outputs of the key NSFC projects in information science & technology during the period 94-01 have increased in both international publications and domestic publications, and the research performances of these projects are generally good.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the research performances of these key projects have been improved in both domestic and international publications, and that the international outputs of these key projects are more productive than the domestic outputs.
the key projects in the information science and technology field funded by NSFC have achieved a relatively good research performance during the period 2001-1994.

, in terms of both international and national performance indicators, there is a positive correlation between the research outputs and the funds invested in the projects, and the research outputs of the key project are increasing.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, for a country like China, it is necessary to take both the domestic and the international outputs of the funded research into account when evaluating the research performance of the funded projects.
, in the field of Information Science & Technology, the key projects funded by NSFC are generally productive, and the research performance of the key projects is increasing.

the CIF is more appropriate than the CSTPC- IF or SCI-IF in the evaluation of research performance of the key projects, and the CIF is also a good indicator for evaluating the research performance of the sub-disciplines of information science &technology in China.
